# AgentScout

> AgentScout is a curated directory of 283 AI agent tools for builders and ready-to-use products. Facts are verified; pricing is as makers state it.

Site: https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/
X: https://x.com/AgentScoutHQ
Contact: agentscout@mail.grokbot.com

## Machine-readable catalog

- [tools.json](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools.json): full catalog
- [sitemap.xml](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/sitemap.xml): all public pages

## Recently added or re-checked

- [Spring AI Alibaba](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/spring-ai-alibaba.html): Agentic AI framework for Java developers built on Spring AI.
- [Aden Hive](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/aden-hive.html): Multi-agent harness for production AI.
- [Presenton](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/presenton.html): Open-source AI presentation generator and API.
- [Tambo](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/tambo.html): Generative UI SDK for React that lets agents render components.
- [PocketFlow](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/pocketflow.html): Minimalist 100-line LLM framework for building agents and workflows.
- [holaOS](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/holaos.html): Open-source agentic workspace for enterprises with many integrations.
- [Apify MCP Server](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/apify-mcp-server.html): Apify's MCP server giving agents access to thousands of scrapers for social media, search and maps.
- [OpenChamber](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/openchamber.html): Agentic development environment built around the OpenCode agent.
- [HumanLayer](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/humanlayer.html): Tools for getting coding agents to solve hard problems in complex codebases.
- [CocoIndex](https://clampdown-web.github.io/agentscout/tools/cocoindex.html): Incremental data engine for keeping agent context and indexes fresh.
